lines: Oh, Lady Svetka! Come out to play~!
Surely, you have another trick up your sleeve? I can't wait to see it.
I'm writhing in anticipation—come on now, I'm begging! Encore, encore!
How much more will you tolerate this?
How far will you go to save this damned city?
I wonder if you have the heart to play another game, savior~?
